title: OpenVEX：產品、子元件與不受影響聲明的適用範圍
titleEn: OpenVEX: product scope, subcomponents and not-affected claims
subcategoryTitle: 軟體來源證明與透明度
summary: 建立12筆產品/元件/漏洞配對，保存purl、版本、摘要、聲明作者及理由；本地假漏洞ID不可與真實已知漏洞結論混用。
summaryEn: Build 12 product/component/vulnerability tuples with purl, version, digest, statement author and rationale. Use clearly fictional vulnerability identifiers so classroom assertions cannot be mistaken for vulnerability advice about a real released product.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. An unusable statement may have the wrong product scope or rationale that does not support the current deployment. Neither alone proves exploitability; it establishes that the evidence is insufficient to justify suppression.
